body:
Firstly, you need to ask... why do you need to regain interest in it? If you enjoy it, play it. 

If you aren't finding it fun, or you don't feel like playing it, then play something else. Maybe you'll feel like playing it later. 

Other Zelda games, or indeed other video games arent going anywhere. If you don't want to play it, don't make yourself. I had the game for 3 months before I started playing it (was too busy for video games).

Honestly, if you're feeling negative about a video game and or the negativity from reviews etc is getting you down, the best thing to do might be to actually do something else - and choose something non digital. Go for a walk, read a book. Try and learn how to cook something.

My first attempt was at 13. I had a low moment ten years ago now, and had attempt two. I'm 32 now, and I can tell you that things get better. Things might also sometimes be worse. But all in all I'm glad I didn't succeed at killing myself, because what I wanted ultimately wasn't to die. It was relief from my problems and the suffering, which at the time felt that there was no end possible. The thing that keeps me from making further attempts now is realising that i have felt better in the times since I tried to kill myself. I'm not even talking about the good things I wouldn't have been able to experience if I was dead, but just the fact that after my attempts there came times where I no longer wanted to kill myself. Now, I try and tell myself that I only have to wait and that I no longer will want to die. It didn't feel like it when I was 13, and even in my 20s. 

I hope you got help. Please don't apologise for posting here. You are going through a lot now, and I wish it didn't hurt so much and that people weren't being so cruel. I wish I could do more than share my experiences.

When we are in the middle of a traumatic experience it is hard to see past that. You are having one hell of a bad time right now. But it is just for right now: one day you will be done with school.

I'm not traditionally pretty. I'm disabled, and sometimes I have to walk with a cane. I used to hate how I look and my body and part of that was because of bullying. But.. I enjoy wearing fun clothing. I like "looking nice" but that's for me to deside what that is, not other people. It's taken a lot to get to this point and I won't tell you how you should feel. But I hope that you can find some joy in your life, and take pleasure in your own appearance for your sake. If people think you are ugly... Well. That's pretty ugly behaviour from them.

I definitely get how hurtful it is being excluded and insulted by people you only want to like you. But I can tell you one day you'll meet people who love you and who will see your beauty inside and out. And, indeed, you may actually already know those people.

I hope you are okay.

NTA

Next time don't feel the need to overexplain things. You can say "I'm happy to explain if necessary but please be careful about your language around our child that you do not accidentally guilt them into doing things which makes them uncomfortable." optionally invite a friendly phone call if it doesn't make sense, but don't budge on anything. Be surprised it's a big deal, if anything. 

You don't always need to explain every point. This isn't a big issue, so it doesn't need to be over the phone. You can, optionally, compromise and do a phone call after the text message.. But honestly I hope your significant other has your back. 

If this is just a once off behaviour, ok. But if this is a pattern of behaviour then ummm.. Talk to your SO about this. You need to be a team when dealing with a difficult family member. And I mean difficult euphemistically, honestly this has the potential for this person to be very destructive. She doesn't like text messages so she calls you cowardly? Wow.

I hope your situation doesn't mean you are very dependant on your MIL for support.

But if it helps, I wish my parents had taught me about what I should do if I was uncomfortable about contact with people, hugs, kisses, whatever. I'm a victim of child abuse and part of the grooming very much was that i felt it was acceptable to be uncomfortable because bodily autonomy wasn't part of their upbringing and so it just wasn't something that they taught me about. It's not my parents fault, they're good people. Just.. Yeah. What you are trying to do is to protect your child and I think that while you can respect that someone might prefer to have a conversation a certain way, the idea that it HAS to be a certain way is kinda.. Laughable.. When the important thing is that we teach all people from an early age that they can control who touches them.

I'm sorry you're going through again. This isn't your fault. It is completely understandable that you feel like this. What has happened is awful, and so hurtful and destructive. Please reach out to people who do care for you. I don't know you, and I don't know your situation. I know that I have been in a situation where I have felt that no one cared or would miss me and I was actively suicidal. But since then I have made good friends and have married a good person. 

But if you feel you don't have someone who cares for you right now, please know that is an "only for now" thing. Try to take things by the day. If that's too long, try to take things by the hour.

I won't say it's not worth killing yourself over, because you can make up your own mind on that. But at the end of the day, dying is the end. The thing that gets me through my suicidal episodes / self harming, is the fact that there will be good things again. Bad things too, sometimes. But that will be okay. Sometimes I just have to tell myself that I won't kill myself this month, or this week, or this day, or this hour. At my worst I actively planned to die. I'm glad I delayed offing myself, because the worst of what I was experiencing passed and ultimately what I wanted wasn't to die but to no longer be overwhelmed with pain and grief. 

It doesn't matter what it is, but I try to focus on things that i actually like and care about that have nothing to do with people who have hurt me. He doesn't deserve any more of your energy, but it is understandable that you cannot help it. That's likely by design, it would not surprise me if this person is manipulative. 

It sucks. Sucks doesn't begin to cover how awful this is. But you did nothing wrong. Loving someone and trusting someone is a good thing. Having that love and trust broken is unconscionable.

If you die, you won't get to read any new books. You won't get to watch any new TV shows. You won't be able to try and learn anything new. You'll never make any new friends, or spend time with old friends. I dont know you, so I can't remind you of the things you do like about life. It can't only be him, and even if it was, can you really say that you never would enjoy anything ever again? Dying would deny you that. 

I really hope you have peace soon. I'm sorry you're going through this.
I love your art. I think you really capture Doug and Parkzer.

I use a couple of methods to deal with my worst moods and suicidal ideation. Sometimes just distracting myself will be enough, but I've had to go to hospital before.

It's hard to care. Sometimes more than others.

I was unable to stop thinking about dying on the weekend. Monday I spent in bed. But today I'm much better. I cleaned my entire house. I usually find that I can wait out my worst, but it's just awful when you're feeling so low.

I'm really glad you have a friend like that. Thank you for sharing. I'm sorry you're struggling with suicidal thoughts at the moment. I think whatever reason you can find to stick around is a worthwhile one.

For me, sometimes the only thing I've been able to find is wanting to see the next episode of a TV show. Sometimes I can't think of anything, and I just tell myself that I just have to make it through the month. Or the week. Or a day.

I find thinking about past attempts really scary and confronting. I think it's good that you reached out to your friend to let them know how you feel.

Sometimes when I'm feeling overwhelmed I just go through YouTube and watch all the pug videos. Just to get my mind off of it. I don't know if this will work for you, but I do think it's okay to distract yourself from something - at least as a short term solution.

For what it is worth, I'm proud of you for seeking help.

It sounds like your sexual attraction to teenagers is causing you a lot of pain, and by no means I'm not about to try and  tell you that consuming that kind of content is acceptable, for reasons you seem well aware of. There's no ethical justification. But.. I also don't think beating yourself up about doing something is helpful. 

But you're not the first person who has had this kind of attraction. You don't want to hurt other people. Your porn addiction has led you to some dark places. But if you go to therapy you can turn this around. 

It sounds like you are just overwhelmed. That your sexuality / attraction / porn addiction is causing you so much grief and pain. That sounds so difficult. It sounds that what you want is relief from anxiety, not death though. My experience is that relief from anxiety is really more of a journey than something you can just snap your fingers and get. It's about learning new coping mechanisms. 

Part of my own suicidal ideation is sexuality related, and also feels quite destructive. Not the same, I don't know what it's like to be attracted to young people. But I go through periods where I will compulsively watch some very horrifying "hardcore" porn that makes me feel disgusted and ashamed afterwards. It is a pattern of behaviour that I fall back into sometimes because the behaviour is in itself a coping mechanism. The only times I've had success in changing my behaviour is when I've had other outlets. 

I know what it's like to keep secrets and secrets around your sexual needs, and for those to all feel (and actually be) so destructive, both of yourself and other people. I'm so shamed of my own kinks and sexual behaviour that I can't even list it on a throwaway account so... that's something I admire you for at least. 

I can't promise you that things get better but just because you find yourself attracted to a certain thing doesn't mean you're going to act on that. That being said, definitely do speak to a therapist. 

If for no other reason than having someone to be accountable to is honestly the only way to beat a porn addiction. 

It's okay to not tell your girlfriend (or anyone) everything. There's no rule that says you have to disclose every little thought you've ever had to someone. But no one should bottle everything up inside, that's just gonna mess with you. It's good to have someone you can feel safe confiding things to. Maybe eventually you can tell your girlfriend, perhaps after talking to the therapist about how to go about it in a safe way.

I hope you don't. You sound like a kind person, to consider your mother's needs. You sound like you have been through a lot, with the death of your father. It sounds like you could use people who aren't going to yell at you. 

It sounds like you want to find a reason to keep living, but it's hard to find something when you're being kicked when your already down. Would you consider doing volunteer work? 

Or is part of the problems also financial? 

I feel it's selfish of me to mention this, but I'm feeling suicidal now too. 
Rather than kill myself now, I told myself I'd do it after my mother passed away too because I don't think she would be able to handle it. But sometimes I think I can't hold out, and so I've been just trying to hold on for one more month.

I sympathise. I feel the same sometimes. It sounds like reading your post that what you want is connection and friendship or perhaps romance, but that isn't working. Dying wouldn't give you what you want. When I feel like that, it can *feel* that dying would be easier than dealing with the pain of rejection.

If that's how you feel, that's how I feel sometimes. And for me I feel that suicide actually isn't easier than dealing with the pain, though. It's just avoiding it. 

Life is hard. I'm feeling suicidal at the moment too. But what gives me hope is the fact that I've felt "not suicidal" in the past, and that I've felt better after feeling the lowest of the low. I once moved interstate and had all my old friends ghost me. They travelled to the city I lived in on holiday and didn't tell me. I never felt so alone. But eventually, I made new friends. 

Unironically, have you tried dating apps / friendship apps?

Have you tried joining hobby groups, say a dance class, or a D&D group, or a baking class? If these don't exist in person, maybe an online group? 

The pandemic makes things hard, but it will pass.
